title: Tant fuz gentement (Johannes Okeghem)
desc: Johannes Okeghem, Tant fuz gentement. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Oke3021); encoded by Jesse Rodin. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
